moments.title: Premier League Weekend Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The Premier League serves up a huge weekend of football, with Manchester United facing Tottenham today and a massive clash between Liverpool and Manchester City tomorrow.

angles.name: Weekend Overview
angles.copy: Premier League weekend is here! Man Utd v Spurs today, then Liverpool v Man City tomorrow. Who are you backing for the big points?

angles.name: Man Utd vs Spurs Hype
angles.copy: Tonight at Old Trafford, it's Manchester United vs Tottenham. Can Spurs continue their strong start or will United dominate at home?

angles.name: Liverpool vs Man City Anticipation
angles.copy: Get ready for the biggest game of the weekend! Liverpool host Manchester City at Anfield tomorrow. Early title decider vibes?

moments.title: Taylor Swift Dominates UK Singles Chart
moments.blurb: Taylor Swift's 'Patient Zero' holds strong at number one on the Official UK Singles Chart, leading a week with several new entries and big movers.

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: Taylor Swift is still queen of the charts! 'Patient Zero' remains at #1 on the Official UK Singles Chart. What's your favourite track from the top 40 right now?

angles.name: New Entries
angles.copy: Beyond Taylor Swift's 'Patient Zero' at #1, there are some big new entries this week from Noah Kahan, Drake, and more! Who are you adding to your playlist?

moments.title: Sŵn Festival Returns to Cardiff

angles.name: Festival Buzz
angles.copy: Sŵn Festival is back! Cardiff will be buzzing with new music from October 15-17 as the multi-venue festival takes over. Who are you hoping to catch?

angles.name: Supporting Welsh Talent
angles.copy: Get ready to discover your new favourite band! Sŵn Festival is a brilliant platform for emerging artists and homegrown Welsh talent. Don't miss it!

moments.title: Bake Off's Audience Choice Week Sparks Chat
moments.blurb: The Great British Bake Off (Series 17) has viewers talking after its 'Audience Choice Week' shook up traditional themes, with judges Paul Hollywood and Nigella Lawson overseeing unique challenges.

angles.name: Bake Off Debate
angles.copy: Bake Off's 'Audience Choice Week' has caused a stir! Did you love the new themes or are you missing the classics like Bread Week? Let us know!

angles.name: Wearable Bakes
angles.copy: From edible fashion to mystery boxes, this week's Bake Off was wild! Who impressed you most with their 'wearable bake' showstopper?

moments.title: Paul Simon Turns 85
moments.blurb: Legendary singer-songwriter Paul Simon, known for his work with Art Garfunkel and his iconic solo career, celebrates his 85th birthday on October 13.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Paul Simon
angles.copy: Happy 85th Birthday to the incredible Paul Simon! From Simon & Garfunkel to Graceland, his music is timeless. What's your favourite Paul Simon track?

angles.name: Simon & Garfunkel Legacy
angles.copy: Celebrating 85 years of Paul Simon this week! His songwriting with Art Garfunkel created some of the most enduring folk-rock hits ever. Which one hits you hardest?

moments.title: Sir Cliff Richard's 86th Birthday
moments.blurb: British music icon Sir Cliff Richard, a chart-topping artist for over six decades, celebrates his 86th birthday on October 14.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Cliff
angles.copy: A very happy 86th birthday to the legendary Sir Cliff Richard on October 14! From 'Move It' to 'Summer Holiday', what's your favourite Cliff hit?

angles.name: British Music Icon
angles.copy: Sir Cliff Richard turns 86 this week! A true British music legend with a career spanning over 65 years. What's your top Cliff Richard memory?

moments.title: Eminem Turns 54
moments.blurb: Marshall Mathers III, better known as the groundbreaking rapper Eminem, celebrates his 54th birthday on October 17.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Eminem
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Eminem on October 17! From 'My Name Is' to 'Lose Yourself', his impact on hip-hop is undeniable. What's your go-to Eminem track?

angles.name: Rap Legend
angles.copy: Celebrating a true rap legend this week! Eminem turns 54 on October 17. Which album of his is your all-time favourite?

moments.title: Laura Marling's Birthday
moments.blurb: Mercury Prize-winning English folk singer-songwriter Laura Marling celebrates her 36th birthday today, October 10.

angles.name: Laura Marling's Day
angles.copy: Happy 36th Birthday to the brilliant Laura Marling! Her distinctive folk sound has earned her critical acclaim and a Mercury Prize. What's your favourite of her albums?

moments.title: BFI London Film Festival Continues
moments.blurb: The prestigious BFI London Film Festival runs until October 18, offering a diverse program of international cinema, premieres, and filmmaker events across the capital.

angles.name: Film Festival Picks
angles.copy: The BFI London Film Festival is in full swing! What films are on your must-see list, or have you already caught a hidden gem?

angles.name: London's Cinema Hub
angles.copy: From red carpet premieres to indie discoveries, the BFI London Film Festival lights up the city until Oct 18. Immerse yourself in the world of film!

moments.title: Cheltenham Literature Festival Ongoing
moments.blurb: The Cheltenham Literature Festival, one of the world's most renowned literary events, continues until October 18 with a packed schedule of author talks and discussions.

angles.name: Literary Event
angles.copy: Bookworms unite! The Cheltenham Literature Festival is still bringing top authors and compelling conversations to the South West until Oct 18. What's on your reading list?

moments.title: New Scientist Live Kicks Off in London
moments.blurb: New Scientist Live, a major science festival featuring talks, demonstrations, and interactive exhibits, opens today at ExCeL London and runs until October 12.

angles.name: Science in London
angles.copy: For all you curious minds, New Scientist Live starts today at ExCeL London! Dive into the latest in science, tech, and health until Monday.

moments.title: Gŵyl Sain Festival in Cardiff
moments.blurb: Welsh independent record label Sain hosts its Gŵyl Sain festival on October 31 in Cardiff, celebrating Welsh music across the decades with live performances and talks.

angles.name: Welsh Music Celebration
angles.copy: Mark your calendars! Gŵyl Sain is back on Oct 31 in Cardiff, celebrating the rich history and future of Welsh music. Essential for any Welsh music fan!

angles.name: Supporting Local Labels
angles.copy: Sain Records is putting on a fantastic festival in Cardiff on Halloween! Get ready for a day of live music and engaging conversations. #WelshCulture

moments.title: New British Dramas on BritBox
moments.blurb: BritBox is releasing several new British dramas this month, including the docuseries 'The Incident Room' (Oct 12) and psychological crime drama 'Patience S1' (Oct 14).

angles.name: BritBox Binge
angles.copy: Your October BritBox binge just got bigger! 'The Incident Room' drops Oct 12 and 'Patience S1' on Oct 14. What British drama are you looking forward to?

angles.name: New Crime Drama
angles.copy: Love a good British crime drama? 'Patience' Season 1, about an autistic records clerk solving murders, arrives on BritBox Oct 14. Add it to your watch list!

moments.title: Exmoor Dark Skies Festival
moments.blurb: The Exmoor Dark Skies Festival runs from October 16 to November 1, offering stargazing events and activities in one of the UK's designated Dark Sky Reserves.

angles.name: Stargazing in Exmoor
angles.copy: Look up! The Exmoor Dark Skies Festival kicks off on Oct 16. Perfect for stargazers and nature lovers right on our doorstep! #ExmoorDarkSkies

angles.name: Autumn Nights
angles.copy: Embrace the darker nights with the Exmoor Dark Skies Festival, starting next week. Discover the wonders of the universe in a breathtaking setting.

moments.title: Swansea's Spooks in the City: Day of the Dead
moments.blurb: Swansea's free Halloween party, 'Spooks in the City,' returns on October 31 with a vibrant Day of the Dead theme, featuring mariachi bands, fire performers, and family activities.

angles.name: Halloween in Swansea
angles.copy: Swansea is going Day of the Dead for Halloween! 'Spooks in the City' on Oct 31 promises mariachi bands, fire performers, and family fun. Get ready to celebrate!

angles.name: Day of the Dead Celebration
angles.copy: Experience a unique Halloween in Swansea with 'Spooks in the City' taking on a vibrant Día de los Muertos theme. Music, dance, and creative crafts awaits!

moments.title: Remembering John Lennon on his Birthday
moments.blurb: Today marks what would have been the 86th birthday of music icon John Lennon, born October 9, 1940, a founding member of The Beatles and a prolific solo artist.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Today, we remember John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon song?

angles.name: Beatles Icon
angles.copy: Thinking of John Lennon on his birthday. His contribution to music with The Beatles and as a solo artist is immeasurable. A true legend.

moments.title: Llais Festival & Welsh Music Prize

angles.name: Welsh Music Prize Tonight
angles.copy: It's the Welsh Music Prize tonight as part of Cardiff's Llais Festival! Who do you think will take home the coveted award for the best Welsh album?

angles.name: Llais Festival Highlights
angles.copy: Cardiff is buzzing with the Llais Festival! Tonight's Welsh Music Prize is a highlight, showcasing the incredible talent from Wales. Don't miss the live performances!
